dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge forming a smooth spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium-radius curvature at the highest point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree linear slope relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow convexity with a wide radius curve transitioning from the blowhole to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak extending with low pixel length and high relative thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white depigmentation mark at the posterior base of the dorsal fin and a distinct cross-hatched geometric pattern on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-pigmented 'saddle' region surrounding the dorsal fin contrasting with a lighter grey-blue body color.
